description: Every Readwise and Reader feature, plus a local mirror of your whole library that you can search, triage and dedupe offline.

novel_features.name: Topic dossier
novel_features.description: Pull every highlight and saved-document passage you have on a topic into one source-attributed, note-ready result.

novel_features.name: Reading backlog and time-budget triage
novel_features.description: See your whole reading debt by location, estimated minutes and age, and pick what fits the time you have.

novel_features.name: Cross-corpus duplicate detection
novel_features.description: Find the same article saved twice, or saved both as a Reader document and as a classic Readwise source.

novel_features.name: Cross-source highlight digest
novel_features.description: Roll up everything you highlighted in a time window across your Readwise books, articles, tweets and podcasts, grouped by source.

novel_features.name: Stale and orphan finder
novel_features.description: Surface forgotten, never-opened saved documents (as Reader IDs you can pass to documents bulk-update) and books with zero highlights.

novel_features.name: What-to-read-next ranker
novel_features.description: Get a short ranked shortlist of unread Reader documents that fit the minutes you have, favouring your preferred location and skipping ones you already started.

novel_features.name: Serendipity connections
novel_features.description: Find items you read months apart that share tags, authors or distinctive terms, from one seed item or across the library.

novel_features.name: Saved-query watches
novel_features.description: Save a query and see only the new matching documents and highlights since the last run.

novel_features.name: Signed webhook delivery
novel_features.description: Register https endpoints that receive new 'watch run --notify' matches, optionally HMAC-signed with a shared secret and SSRF-checked before delivery.
